summary: Iteration 4 (multi check-in per day + device telemetry capture + Device column/dialog in admin + removal of telemetry-sharing sentence) verified end-to-end via Playwright. All 3 review goals PASS. Pre-existing blocker fixed: stray closing tags ('Dialog>', '</motion.div>', '}') after the DeviceBlock function in /app/frontend/src/pages/admin/LiveMonitor.js were causing a parse error and the frontend would not compile (webpack 'Parsing error: Unexpected token (249:5)'). After removing the dangling lines the bundle compiled successfully and all flows became testable.

issues: In headless Chromium device_name falls back to 'Linux' so the Device cell renders 'Linux · Linux' (device_name · OS) which looks duplicated. On real browsers with navigator.userAgentData this collapses correctly. Consider de-duplicating when device_name === os in AttendanceTab.js line 42 to avoid the 'Linux · Linux' presentation.

action_items: (Optional, low) AttendanceTab.js: render device as `device_name` only when `device_name === os` (avoids 'Linux · Linux' duplication in headless / privacy-restricted UAs).
critical_code_review_comments: BLOCKER (fixed by tester): LiveMonitor.js had four stray lines (`Dialog>`, `</motion.div>`, `);`, `}`) appended after the DeviceBlock function — clearly a copy-paste leftover from refactoring. This caused a hard ESLint/Babel parse error and the SPA would not load. Main agent should audit recent edits to ensure no other files have similar leftover fragments.

useLocationTracker.getDeviceInfo() runs `navigator.userAgentData.getHighEntropyValues` inside a try/catch but does not check `isSecureContext`; on http previews this throws each ping. Safe to keep (caught) but emits noisy console warnings — consider gating on `window.isSecureContext`.

Frontend `doAction('checkin' | 'checkout')` in EmployeeHome.js sends both `pos` and `device` together; on permission-denied the call still fires with empty pos object which is fine, but no UX message is shown to the user explaining that GPS was unavailable. Consider toast.warning when getCurrentPosition() returns null.

LiveMonitor merges live.device and attendance.check_in_device in three places using `(it.live?.device || it.attendance?.check_in_device)` — extract into a single `const deviceForRow = ...` to avoid divergence if the precedence rule ever changes.

Sessions-today counter is computed server-side (good), but Worked Today on a freshly-completed sub-second session showed '0h 0m' even after a real round trip — this is a rounding issue (Math.floor on near-zero seconds). Acceptable for production where sessions are minutes long.

rca of the issue: ROOT CAUSE of frontend not loading: /app/frontend/src/pages/admin/LiveMonitor.js lines 248-251 contained orphan closing tokens (`Dialog>`, `</motion.div>`, `);`, `}`) after the `DeviceBlock` function. These appear to be a left-over from a refactor where the dialog JSX was moved out of the original return block but the closing fragments weren't cleaned up. Babel parser threw 'Unexpected token (249:5)' and webpack failed compilation, leaving the entire SPA blank. FIX applied by tester: deleted those 4 lines so the file ends cleanly after the `DeviceBlock` function's closing `}`. After save (hot reload) webpack output: 'Compiled successfully!'. All subsequent UI tests pass.
